5 تتوّج He was, or became, crowned, or invested with the crown. (S, A, K.) [For the verb تَاجَ, in this or a similar sense, mentioned in the Lexicons of Golius and Freytag, in the former as from the K, I find no authority: on the contrary, it is said in the TA that no verb answering to تَائِجٌ has been heard.] ―
-b2- He was made, or became, a prince, lord, or chief. (TA.) ―
-b3- (assumed tropical:) He was, or became, turbaned, or invested with the turban. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
